ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the graph: the figure is an asymptotic Bode phase plot, the horizontal axis is logarithmic frequency ω, and positions such as 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100 rad/s are marked; the vertical-axis phase marks 0°, -45°, -135°, -225°, -270°. The curve remains at 0° before 0.01 rad/s, and from 0.01 to 0.1 rad/s decreases to about -45°; from 0.1 to 10 rad/s it continuously decreases with a larger slope, passing through about -135° at 1 rad/s and reaching about -225° at 10 rad/s; from 10 to 100 rad/s it continues to decrease to -270°, and then remains at -270°. Therefore the phase-slope change intervals on the graph can be read as: 0.01 to 0.1, 0.1 to 10, 10 to 100 rad/s. Then reason: for a first-order pole s+a, its asymptotic phase transition usually goes from a/10 to 10a, with a total change of -90° and a slope of -45° per decade. The known pole 0.1 has a phase transition interval from 0.01 to 1 rad/s; the known pole 10 has a phase transition interval from 1 to 100 rad/s. In the graph, the descending slope between 0.1 and 10 rad/s is equivalent to twice the slope of a single pole, indicating that in this interval there is also the phase transition of an additional pole p1 acting. The transition interval of this additional pole is p1/10 to 10p1. From the graph it can be matched as p1/10 = 0.1 and 10p1 = 10, so p1 = 1.

method.method_draft: From the image, list the frequency intervals where the phase-slope changes. The known pole at 0.1 accounts for an active phase transition from 0.01 to 1 rad/s. The known pole at 10 accounts for an active transition from 1 to 100 rad/s. The plotted curve has an additional pole active from 0.1 to 10 rad/s, because the slope is doubled between 0.1 and 10 compared with a single-pole slope. For a pole whose transition runs from p1/10 to 10p1, match p1/10=0.1 and 10p1=10, giving p1=1.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是渐近 Bode 相位图，横轴为对数频率 ω，标出了 0.01、0.1、1、10、100 rad/s 等位置；纵轴相位标出了 0°、-45°、-135°、-225°、-270°。曲线在 0.01 rad/s 之前保持 0°，从 0.01 到 0.1 rad/s 下降到约 -45°；从 0.1 到 10 rad/s 以更大的斜率连续下降，经过 1 rad/s 处约 -135°，到 10 rad/s 处约 -225°；从 10 到 100 rad/s 继续下降到 -270°，之后保持 -270°。因此图上的相位斜率变化区间可读为：0.01 到 0.1、0.1 到 10、10 到 100 rad/s。再推理：对于一个一阶极点 s+a，其渐近相位过渡通常从 a/10 到 10a，总变化为 -90°，斜率为每十倍频 -45°。已知极点 0.1 的相位过渡区间是 0.01 到 1 rad/s；已知极点 10 的相位过渡区间是 1 到 100 rad/s。图中在 0.1 到 10 rad/s 之间的下降斜率相当于单个极点斜率的两倍，说明此区间内还有一个额外极点 p1 的相位过渡在作用。该额外极点的过渡区间为 p1/10 到 10p1。由图可匹配为 p1/10 = 0.1 且 10p1 = 10，所以 p1 = 1。
